sources.summary: Google Research has released TabFM, a foundation model for tabular data. It performs zero-shot classification and regression through in-context learning. Predictions come from a single forward pass, with no per-dataset training, hyperparameter tuning, or feature engineering. The post Google AI Introduces TabFM: A Hybrid-Attention Tabular Foundation Model for Zero-Shot Classification and Regression appeared first on MarkTechPost .
